fieldNotes.location: Confirmed via Street View — building bears 'DR PEPPER SNAPPLE' signage and '8150' address numerals on the east (office) face. Address 8150 Georgetown Rd, Indianapolis, IN 46268, in the Park 100 industrial area. Roster lat/lng were Indianapolis city-center (geocode moved 12.8 km); resolved correct site by web research.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Open paved driveways connect the public road (Georgetown Rd) to the property's loop driveway and yard. Street View of the NE entrance shows no barrier arm, sliding gate, or pinch-point — free-flowing curb cut. A chain-link property-line fence runs along part of the east boundary but no controlled gate across the truck lane was observed. truckGate = false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth observed at any entrance in satellite or Street View. guardShack = false.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: remoteGs is false because there is no truck gate.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors are on the NW long face of the building (trailers backed in, several with tractors visible in z20 imagery). Estimated ~22 doors — band 10-25. Count is approximate from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A dedicated trailer drop row of ~30-40 marked stalls runs along the west side of the property between the building and the retention pond; many trailers parked nose-out without tractors. Band 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropYard: true — dedicated trailer storage row west of the building, separate from active dock apron.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large open paved yard area on the NW side of the building (with a circular landscaped island) provides substantial internal queue/maneuvering space before the docks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide open paved entrance aprons and a large internal paved yard provide ample room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Park 100 industrial park within the Indianapolis metro (NW side) — Urban.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Single KDP building. Adjacent large buildings (gray-roof facility to the NW, buildings to the south) are separate properties, not part of this campus.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
